newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise across the board.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Wednesday, with bullish sentiment carried over from the previous day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen to 2.1 yen per kg higher. Benchmark January was up 1.1 yen at 125.6 yen.
"Private investors, who sold to take profits at the opening, built fresh longs later in the day. Growing views that the market has bottomed out stimulated buying," a trader said.
"The benchmark is expected to probe the upside at 130.0 yen if speculative interest grows," he said. Gains in other Japanese commodity futures also helped lift sentiment.
